verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents its own export capability: traces can be filtered and exported via the UI or API. Self-hosting also keeps trace and operational data inside your own infrastructure, which eases leaving. However, the evidence covers only traces, and nothing names the export formats or shows a complete account-wide export. missing for 10: export of all data types (datasets, experiments, feedback, prompts, dashboards), documented open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/OTel), a bulk full-account export or offboarding path, independent corroboration.
